providers.name: openai
providers.note: OpenAI-compatible embeddings: /v1/embeddings (also Azure Foundry /openai/v1/embeddings) and the Azure /deployments/* api-version route; input tokens only, so completion_optional. Listed before the chat and Responses entries and guarded by root_object 'list' (the embeddings envelope) so it does not claim a generation body that omits or zeroes its completion count.

providers.name: openai
providers.note: OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions across OpenAI API (incl. regional us./eu.), Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry /openai/v1, and Bedrock Mantle/Runtime /openai/v1. `$` keeps the stored-completion endpoints (/chat/completions/{id}) out; /deployments/*/completions is the Azure api-version route.

providers.name: openai
providers.note: OpenAI image generation and edits (gpt-image-1), OpenAI API only. Usage shares input_tokens/output_tokens with the Responses API, so this entry is placed before Responses and requires output_tokens_details.image_tokens, which image responses carry and Responses does not.

providers.name: openai
providers.note: OpenAI Responses API, same hosts as Chat Completions (incl. Azure /openai/responses and /deployments/*). Parsing is host-independent and anthropic shares the input/output_tokens keys, so this entry stays before anthropic and requires input_tokens_details; `$` keeps GET /v1/responses/{id} and the unbilled /responses/input_tokens out while /compact is billed.

providers.name: openai
providers.note: OpenAI audio transcription and translation (gpt-4o-transcribe), OpenAI API only. required_field 'type' (usage.type) keeps it before and apart from anthropic, which shares input_tokens/output_tokens but has no usage.type; the duration variant (type=duration, no tokens) carries no input_tokens and is not recorded.

providers.name: anthropic
providers.note: Anthropic Messages across Claude API, Claude Platform on AWS, Bedrock Mantle /anthropic/v1, Claude on Google Cloud, and Claude in Microsoft Foundry /anthropic/v1. `$` keeps /v1/messages/count_tokens and /v1/messages/batches out.

providers.name: gemini
providers.note: Gemini API and Vertex embeddings (:embedContent, :batchEmbedContents); input tokens only, so completion_optional, and usageMetadata is often absent (then counted as usage_absent, not recorded). Listed before the chat entry and guarded by required_root_field 'embedding' (the single-embedding envelope) so it does not claim a chat body, which also reads usageMetadata.promptTokenCount with completion_optional; the response has no model field, so the model stays unknown.

providers.name: gemini
providers.note: Gemini generateContent and streamGenerateContent across Gemini API and Vertex AI (global, {region}-aiplatform, multi-region us/eu); path matching is case-sensitive (the streaming method is :streamGenerateContent).

providers.name: gemini
providers.note: Gemini Interactions API: POST /v1beta/interactions and /v1/interactions, and Vertex /locations/*/interactions (streaming signalled by a body stream flag, no custom verb); same hosts as generateContent. required_field total_input_tokens keeps this entry off other providers' top-level usage.

providers.name: anthropic
providers.note: Claude on Vertex AI (global and {region}-aiplatform, multi-region us/eu): Anthropic body, model in the path. `claude-` keeps count-tokens:rawPredict and custom endpoints out.

providers.name: bedrock
providers.note: Bedrock Runtime Converse and ConverseStream (binary eventstream, same usage in the last metadata event); Converse inputTokens excludes cache tokens. InvokeModel returns the model's own body, so only Anthropic models (anthropic.*/invoke, read by the anthropic entry) are matched here.

providers.name: bedrock
providers.note: Bedrock Runtime InvokeModelWithResponseStream, every model: usage is in the last eventstream chunk's amazon-bedrock-invocationMetrics. Anthropic models are read by the anthropic entry first (from the merged message_start and message_delta usage), so this covers the others.

providers.name: anthropic-agents
providers.note: Claude Managed Agents session paths (/v1/sessions, /v1/sessions/*/events), api.anthropic.com only; record_only makes the processor count each call under the agent_session reason and never read the response, whose usage is a running session total. required_field list_cost keeps the entry from matching another provider's response in the host-independent usage parse.
